agent_review.author: agent

findings.summary: Actions 18-20 repeatedly selected Bug Bite while Bugatti's verified sleep counter guaranteed no action; Sunflora received three free Sludge Bomb turns and KO'd Bugatti.

resolution.observed: A bounded worst-case replay switched to Croakatoa, which survived a critical Sludge Bomb at 6/46 HP and preserved 30-HP Bugatti; hybrid-policy-v17 now overrides profile switch vetoes during deterministic sleep/freeze turns and selects Croakatoa.

findings.summary: Action 6 was initially labeled interrupted because the retained text tail omitted Ice Shard, although Ponyta's authoritative HP fell from 13 to 10 before Flame Wheel KO'd Lildozer.

resolution.observed: battle-step-v6 uses verified opponent HP/status/stage deltas as execution evidence; replaying the same state/action now reports executed with no discrepancies.

findings.summary: Lildozer fainted after two Bulldozes and one verified priority Ice Shard, but those actions consumed Ponyta's Sitrus line and enabled fresh-entry Fake Out plus poison to finish it; no switch-only stall occurred.
Bushtank fainted to poison immediately after its fourth Razor Leaf KO'd Eelektrik; it completed its reserved objective and preserved full-HP Croakatoa, so no legal alternative was shown to dominate.
Birdlaw fainted after two Aerial Aces into Dustox's Venoshock and Infestation, but forced-entry Ohmnomnom immediately finished Dustox; no extra no-action pivot occurred.

All nine switches had a role: two matchup entries, two Fake Out relays, two endgame pivots, and three forced replacements. Every voluntary replacement acted before leaving; there was no immediate switch reversal or no-action switch spam.
The fight used 29 decisions; removing three guaranteed sleep failures should shorten the next attempt and preserve Bugatti.

correct_choices: Croakatoa pivoted directly to Bushtank against Eelektrik; Bushtank entered at 51/57 HP and won the matchup with four Razor Leafs.
Ohmnomnom used fresh-entry Fake Out twice and switched only after each free hit, so both relays created progress rather than switch spam.
Ohmnomnom switched to Bugatti against Sunflora; Bugatti survived Energy Ball at 30/41 HP and landed Bug Bite before GrassWhistle.
Croakatoa switched to Birdlaw against Dustox, Birdlaw attacked twice, and the forced Ohmnomnom entry finished the battle.
The terminal state authoritatively verified victory with Ohmnomnom at 13 HP and Croakatoa at 6 HP.
